Strongest counterargument & upset scenario

Opposing case: High altitude and neutral-court travel in Mexico City can produce unusual shooting variance that rewards Indiana’s high-volume perimeter pace.

Upset scenario: Indiana turns the game into a track meet, forces early Denver turnovers and hits double-digit first-half threes.

International neutral-site games carry abnormal travel and altitude fatigue factors that increase game-to-game variance.
